final_order_selection.status: highest completed common order; convergence is assessed only by the separate spatial and temporal flags, never merely by file presence

convergence_flags.threshold: relative L2 < 1% componentwise; time refinement has been checked only at p4

protocol_attribution.geometry_difference_self_convergence_not: Useful sensitivity diagnostic only; it is not the numerical-error basis of the original five-times gate because common-mode cancellation is possible.
protocol_attribution.interpretation: This is the protocol's numerical-attribution diagnostic, not proof of a physical causal mechanism.
protocol_attribution.primary_numerical_error_proxy: conservative spatial sum ||raster p5 s36 - p4 s36|| + ||curved p5 s36 - p4 s36||; no common-mode cancellation is assumed
protocol_attribution.protocol_criterion: PROTOCOL.md: a geometry difference no more than five times the numerical-error estimate cannot be confidently attributed to smoothing.
protocol_attribution.temporal_error_proxy: separate p4 transfer: ||raster p4 s36 - p4 s18|| + ||curved p4 s36 - p4 s18||; it is not combined with the spatial proxy and does not establish p5 temporal convergence
